in_marathi.name: लक्ष्मण
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Younger brother of Rama, God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: लक्ष्मण हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, लक्ष्मण (Lakshmana) is the younger brother of Lord Rama, an avatar of Vishnu, and an embodiment of purity, loyalty, and strength. He is also known as the God of Wealth (Lakshmi's brother). In the epic Ramayana, Lakshmana helps Rama in defeating the demon king Ravana, and later, he accompanies Rama in his exile and rule over Ayodhya.

in_bengali.long_meaning: लक्ष्मण একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, लक्ष्मण (Lakshmana) is the younger brother of Lord Rama, an avatar of Vishnu, and an embodiment of purity, loyalty, and strength. He is also known as the God of Wealth (Lakshmi's brother). In the epic Ramayana, Lakshmana helps Rama in defeating the demon king Ravana, and later, he accompanies Rama in his exile and rule over Ayodhya.
